description:
Step back into the cybergrunge city of Port Desire in the latest trailer, which premiered at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026. 

Welcome to Port Desire, a lawless city where violence, ambition, and consequence shape every street.  Enter a dense cyber-noir world where every choice has consequences, and you reap what you sow.  

*This gameplay trailer contains actual in-game footage. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.  

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗡𝗢 𝗟𝗔𝗪 
NO LAW is a single-player immersive open-world FPS RPG coming to PC and consoles. Set in the dangerous streets of Port Desire, NO LAW puts you in the role of Grey Harker, a former soldier pulled back into a life he thought he had left behind. The city knows him only in whispers: an artist, a ghost, a bulldozer, a tactician. Some call him "The Gardener."

title: NO LAW | Official Gameplay Trailer | Gamescom ONL 2026

author: Epic Games
description:
Hello, traveler from afar.
This planet has awaited you for a long, long time.
Here, days are filled with warmth and companionship,
and in the quiet moments between,
little joys find room to grow.
Take a flower,
and drift into the depths of the Starsea,
until stars see stars,
and I see you.
And so, myriad planets light up one by one,
connecting into a tapestry of starlight.
And we will finally meet,
right where the stars bloom.

*The game is still in development. Content shown in this test does not represent the final quality of the game.
